title: INBOX.md Entry (STORY-2 v2)
description: Structured human-to-agent communication entry. Replaces free-form markdown INBOX.md to prevent prompt injection. See tasks/2026-07-11-epic-integration-anima-sdk-v2-a27f5a.md for context.

author.description: Who created this entry. The orchestrator's normal flow expects 'human'.

intent.description: Why this entry exists. redirect/abort halt or change agent course; clarify asks for more info; context adds knowledge; ack acknowledges.

target.description: Optional agent name or task_id this entry is directed at. If null, applies to the most recent active task.

body.description: Plain text body. NO markdown, NO HTML, NO code. Sanitized before injection into system prompt.

knowledge_anchor.description: Required when intent in {redirect, context}: must reference a section in KNOWLEDGE.md. Format: '#section-name' or 'section-name'.

ack_required.description: If true, the agent must emit a corresponding bus event with type=inbox_ack before proceeding.

allOf.description: When intent is 'redirect' or 'context', knowledge_anchor is required.
